Scary, right?  

Even scarier -- the bill House Republicans passed contains a provision that bans states from ANY regulations on AI for the next 10 years.  The Senate needs to stop this. https://t.co/hjbaRidQC0
statements.quoted: Some of the most powerful AI models today have exhibited behaviors that mimic a will to survive by sabotaging shutdown commands, blackmailing engineers or copying themselves to external servers without permission.  https://t.co/tgjOpJUvE4

statements.text: the majority attempted to condition BEAD funding on States agreeing to not regulate artificial intelligence for 10 years. I am concerned about how this would threaten online safety, jeopardize data privacy, and spread misinformation.
statements.context: Remarks by Ms. Morrison during a panel or hearing titled "Wired for Growth: How Expanding Broadband Can Revitalize Rural Small Businesses," questioning witness Ms. Jackson-Furman about broadband program conditions.

statements.text: The growth of AI, both in use and in development, has spurred an explosion in data-center construction, which has caused a huge rise in demand for the electricity they need to function as well as for water used by some data centers' liquid cooling systems.
statements.venue: House Small Business subcommittee hearing 'Empowering Rural America Through Investment in Innovation' (opening statement, transcript)

statements.text: First, data centers are causing residential customers' electric bills to rise by increasing electricity demand and straining the electric grid. [...] It is possible to build more data centers in a way that doesn't hamper innovation but also benefits the communities that surround them. We should be thoughtful and purposeful about the way we are building data centers.
statements.venue: House Small Business subcommittee hearing 'Empowering Rural America Through Investment in Innovation' (opening statement, transcript)

statements.text: Emerging technologies like AI and blockchains are redefining how people around the world live and work.
statements.context: Opening remarks by Ms. Morrison at a congressional hearing titled 'Empowering Rural America Through Investment in Innovation,' focused on data-center impacts on rural communities.

statements.text: AI tools of all kinds are readily available and some have the potential to support entrepreneurs. But I do worry that as tech giants race ahead to push out their next AI model, there is insufficient attention on the actual utility of this technology to our small business owners and, frankly, to the American people.
statements.venue: House Small Business Committee hearing 'AI on Main Street' (transcript)

statements.text:
The call is coming from inside the house. AI researchers themselves are warning of an existential threat to humanity.

Congress can’t wait. Mike Johnson needs to cancel recess so we can get to work immediately – hearings, investigations, and comprehensive regulation. https://t.co/9ovsX3V3SA
statements.quoted: I resigned from Anthropic today. I spent the last three years doing pretraining research at both OpenAI and Anthropic. Neither company is acting responsibly. They are racing straight to self-improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives. More thoughts below.

statements.text: The threat from AI is serious. We need a president who will take it seriously. https://t.co/L3zXDLUFin
statements.quoted: Trump tells the UN he is officially changing the name of Artificial Intelligence to "Super Intelligence" and says all US government documents will now be changed to refer to "SI" https://t.co/LEWbc5tn3B
